# The old setup-tab removal deletes disabled tests while enabling Hub entry points

The three removed legacy tests were already disabled with the stated removal bug in their parent manifests. The surviving Hub entry-point tasks lose the old experiment-pref skip, while the menubar and message-window cases still skip macOS. Their shared helper directly checks the dialog and selected visible form, then waits for close. This is a test-selection and entry-point change, not proof of replacement coverage for the deleted account creation, password, linked-service or cancel flows.

Scope: Account creation removal and browser-test scope.
